# Alex Bodnia

> Alex Bodnia (Oleksandr Bodnia, Олександр Бодня) is a UX/UI designer and front-end developer with 5+ years of experience. He designs websites, mobile apps, packaging and 3D visualizations, and carries them from structure and interface through to a finished build in React, Next.js and Framer. Available for projects worldwide. Works in English and Ukrainian.

Canonical site: https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app

## Summary
- Role: UX/UI & Product Designer and front-end developer (independent practice since 2022).
- Services: UX/UI design, website design and development, mobile app design, packaging design, 3D visualization.
- Tools & technologies: Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer, Webflow, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Blender.
- Languages: English, Ukrainian.

## Experience
- 2022 - present: Independent UX/UI & Product Designer. Websites, mobile apps, packaging and 3D visualizations for clients, from research and wireframes to Figma prototypes and front-end builds.
- 2021 - 2022: Voronin Design Studio. Design intern working on client website projects.
- 2018 - 2022: IT Step University. Computer science studies and internships in design and front-end development.

## Selected works (case studies)
- [Medis - healthcare website](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/medis-healthcare): user-friendly digital experience for a healthcare product, focused on trust, accessibility and clear navigation. UX/UI, web design, mobile version.
- [Nasha Khata - fences, gates and doors](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/nasha-hata-real-estate): improved UX and visuals and designed the full mobile version of a manufacturer's website.
- [Tvoe - Emotion Factory (gifts)](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/tvoe-web-design): web design and mobile layouts focused on usability and clear information structure.
- [Vespera Funeral Home](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/vespera-funeral-home): bilingual service website designed in Figma and built in Framer with a CMS.
- [Dnipro.net redesign](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/dnipro-redesign): full redesign of an internet provider's website with clearer navigation and a modern interface.
- [Tennis Courts 3D (Lviv)](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/tennis-courts-3d): 3D model built in Blender from a technical drawing, with materials and renders. The project won the tender and the complex was built.
- [CycleSense period tracker app](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/mobile-app-cyclesense): mobile app design with a calm, approachable interface.
- [CryptoX trading app](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/mobile-app-cryptoxapp): minimalist crypto trading app for fast, distraction-free portfolio tracking.
- [Responsive to-do mobile app](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/mobile-app-todo): cross-platform task app with a clean, intuitive interface.
- [Ketotox Plus medical packaging](https://alexbodniawebsite.vercel.app/work/ketotox-package): packaging design combining a clear layout with hand-drawn illustrations.
